security_audit.summary: The skill is primarily a Markdown guide for inference.sh social media workflows. Most shell-backtick detections are Markdown fence artifacts, but several examples do run third-party CLI commands. The remote curl-to-shell installer at SKILL.md line 21 is confirmed as a critical risk.

remediation.issue: Remote installer is piped directly into sh.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the pipe-to-shell install step with signed release downloads, checksum verification, or package manager instructions.

remediation.issue: Examples rely on third-party CLI execution through infsh.
remediation.suggestion: Document expected network destinations, data sent to providers, and require confirmation before running commands.

remediation.issue: Related skills are installed with npx commands from a community repository.
remediation.suggestion: Pin exact versions or commit refs and instruct users to review each skill before installation.

remediation.issue: The Twitter/X example can publish content externally.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation and explain credential scope before any social posting command runs.

content.user_title: Create Social Media Assets with AI
content.value_statement: Social teams need platform-ready visuals and copy quickly. This skill provides prompts and CLI workflows for videos, images, captions, hashtags, and repurposed posts.
actual_capabilities: Provides infsh commands for TikTok, Reels, Shorts, and other vertical video formats.
Shows workflows for Instagram carousel images, YouTube thumbnails, and Twitter/X visuals.
Chains script writing, text-to-speech, and AI avatar generation for talking-head content.
Generates caption, hashtag, and hook prompts for social media posts.
Includes batch creation and multi-platform repurposing examples for repeated content production.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI, account access, and network connectivity.
Model quality, speed, cost, and availability depend on external providers.
Social publishing requires separate credentials and user approval.
Generated media still needs review for brand fit, rights, accuracy, and platform rules.

use_cases.title: Launch Short-Form Campaigns
use_cases.description: Create vertical video concepts and supporting captions for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts.

use_cases.title: Batch Creator Assets
use_cases.description: Produce weekly visuals, hooks, captions, and voiceover concepts from a topic list.

use_cases.title: Prepare Product Visuals
use_cases.description: Generate product showcase prompts, thumbnails, and shareable social graphics for launches.

prompt_templates.title: Create One Short Video
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a single platform asset.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create one TikTok video concept for my topic. Include aspect ratio, duration, visual prompt, caption, and hashtags.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Carousel Set
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a multi-image post.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a five-slide Instagram carousel for this theme. Keep the visual style consistent and include captions for each slide.

prompt_templates.title: Repurpose Across Platforms
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for one idea across several channels.
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn this concept into TikTok, Twitter/X, YouTube thumbnail, and Instagram feed assets. Explain the format choices for each platform.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Weekly Content Batch
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a seven-day content batch for these topics. Include video prompts, captions, hashtags, and review notes for each post.

output_examples.input: Request: Create a TikTok concept for a new coffee brand.
output: Vertical 9:16 video prompt with close-up coffee preparation and morning light.
Caption with a clear hook, product benefit, and call to action.
Hashtag set focused on coffee, mornings, small business, and lifestyle content.

output_examples.input: Request: Repurpose a productivity tip across three platforms.
output: TikTok prompt using fast cuts and text overlays.
Twitter/X visual prompt for a square infographic.
YouTube thumbnail prompt with bold contrast and a simple headline area.

output_examples.input: Request: Make a talking-head workflow for a 30-second tutorial.
output: Short script prompt with a hook, lesson, and closing action.
Voiceover guidance with a named voice option.
Avatar video prompt that combines the generated voice and selected image.

best_practices: Review installer commands and CLI credentials before running any example.
Provide platform, aspect ratio, duration, audience, brand style, and review criteria.
Check generated assets for rights, accuracy, disclosure needs, and platform policy before publishing.
anti_patterns: Running remote installers or npx install commands without verification.
Publishing automated social posts without explicit human approval.
Using generic viral prompts without audience, brand, or policy constraints.

faq.question: Does this skill require inference.sh?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflows are written for the inference.sh CLI and its hosted model apps.

faq.question: Can it create videos and images?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides CLI examples for video, image, thumbnail, avatar, and voice workflows.

faq.question: Can it write captions and hashtags?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes prompt patterns for captions, hashtags, hooks, and calls to action.

faq.question: Does it publish directly to social networks?
faq.answer: It includes a Twitter/X automation example, but publishing needs credentials and explicit approval.

faq.question: Is the installer command safe to run automatically?
faq.answer: No. The remote pipe-to-shell installer should be replaced or manually verified before use.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
